asset: AR-01 assault rifle (generic AK-pattern): reference measurement of the user's sheet
tool: WorkFiles/guns/rifle/tools/trace_reference.py (regenerates this file, trace/ and the overlay)

frame.axes: +X toward the muzzle, +Z up, +Y = gun left (right-handed)
frame.origin: X = 0 at the rearmost point of the butt plate; Z = 0 on the bore axis (barrel centre line fitted on the exposed barrel between the gas block and the front sight block); Y = 0 on the mid-plane
frame.units: mm unless the key ends in _px

scale.uncertainty_note: unc_mm = 1-sigma measurement uncertainty from the edge types (silhouette +-0.4 px, hand-placed seam +-1 px, estimate +-2 px) at that view's scale; the 880 mm scale choice adds +-1.5 % to every length on top

left_vs_right.method: RIGHT panel mirrored; both views put in the gun frame independently (own bore axis, X = 0 at the rearmost butt point, own scale so the overall length is 880 mm) and compared without any fitting; a free similarity fit (max IoU) is given as a secondary number

profile_diff_RIGHT_minus_LEFT_mm.note: outermost top / bottom silhouette Z at stations every 10 mm (RIGHT minus LEFT)

barrel.note: a round barrel reads the same in both views if both are orthographic at the same scale

perspective.conclusion: No measurable perspective in LEFT, RIGHT or TOP: the barrel edges are straight lines to 0.08 px rms over the exposed barrel, the bore axis is level to 0.06 deg in LEFT, the front sight hood's front edge is vertical to 1.3 deg, and LEFT / mirrored RIGHT / TOP have the same overall length in px to within 0.8 %. The views are treated as orthographic. What does differ between them is the drawing itself (part positions shift by up to ~16 mm, the barrel reads 14.8 / 15.5 / 16.7 mm): image-generator inconsistency, not projection.

authority.lengths_heights_XZ: LEFT (all parts traced; sharpest); RIGHT is the cross-check
authority.widths_Y: TOP (the only view showing widths); magazine thickness and butt plate width cross-checked with the close-ups
authority.magazine: LEFT (in place on the rifle); close-ups only for the rib pattern and thickness ratio
authority.details: close-ups and the 3/4 view for surface features only (not to scale)

length.how: rearmost butt plate point to muzzle brake tip, along the bore (set = 880)

height_with_magazine.how: front sight hood top to magazine floor plate bottom

height_without_magazine.how: front sight hood top to pistol grip bottom

diameter.how: mean top-bottom edge distance of the exposed barrel between gas block and front sight block (56 columns, sd 0.10 px)

diameter_behind_gas_block.how: same, between handguard front band and gas block (between the two see-through gaps)

muzzle_end_X.how: barrel muzzle taken at the brake rear face (front of the front sight block collar)

diameter_exposed.how: exposed vented section; its top edge is a backdrop-coloured highlight (force_fg patch), so that edge is +-1-2 px

rear_X_visible.how: front of the rear sight block

exposed_length.how: handguard front band to gas block shoulder

cleaning_rod.note: runs under the barrel from the lower handguard to the front sight block lug

length.how: rear end cap (stock socket) to front face

bottom_Z.how: silhouette bottom between magazine and lower handguard

side_top_Z.how: dust cover / receiver seam at the front

notch_X_est.how: rear end of the leaf top (the notch itself is not resolved)

muzzle_brake.front_face_note: front cut slopes back from the bottom lip (front) to the top; positive = bottom ahead of the top

length_along_axis.how: receiver bottom seam to grip bottom, along the grip axis

pistol_grip.note: rake = how far the grip leans back (bottom toward the butt) from the perpendicular to the bore; X = k*Z + c fits of the front and rear edges

length_butt_to_receiver.how: rearmost butt plate point to the wood / receiver-cap seam

heel_Z.how: top rear corner of the wood

toe_Z.how: bottom rear corner of the wood

stock.note: comb = highest top point of the stock ahead of the butt; wrist = the dip behind the receiver; negative Z = below the bore

butt_plate.rear_face_note: fit X = k*Z + c of the rear face; positive angle = the top (heel) is further forward than the toe

width_from_top_view.how: max width behind the stock wood

concentric_fit.note: the magazine curves forward: the centre of curvature is ahead of it, so the front edge is the inner (concave) arc and the rear edge the outer (convex) arc; both fitted as concentric arcs about one centre (floor plate excluded)

width_front_to_rear_radial.how: R_rear - R_front of the concentric fit

ribs_side_view.method: mean normalised luminance on 7 radial lines across the arc; 0 = rear (outer) edge, 1 = front (inner) edge; peaks = bright rib crests / edge highlights

mag_catch.note: the catch lever hangs from the receiver directly behind the magazine's rear (concave) edge

thickness_from_front_closeup.how: front close-up width/height ratio x the LEFT view's vertical magazine height (assumes the close-up shows the same full height); +-10 %

sight_radius_est.how: rear leaf rear end to front hood centre

heights.note: the front post is hidden inside the hood in the side views; the hood top is an upper bound for the sight line at the muzzle end

butt_plate_width.how: max width behind the stock wood

receiver_body_width_plain_section.how: median over the plain middle section of the receiver (no lateral features)

magazine_left_closeup.note: drawn curving the other way from the rifle's left view (front edge on the left), i.e. really a right-side view; used for the rib pattern only

butt_plate_end.shape: stadium (long rounded rectangle) with a raised rim and two slotted screws on the centre line near each end
